agent_notes: The exact NIRF government listing was established for the Amla campus. The official District Betul directory confirms the campus as Govt Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar College, Amla, in Betul district and links http://www.mphighereducation.nic.in/betul.

The linked official higher-education homepage did not return content within command-line HTTPS timeouts, and no official programme/course/admissions catalogue could be established; therefore the record is manual_review and no courses were imported.

Normal TLS first returned curl error 60 for the managed proxy certificate chain. curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected official and government hostnames. No credentials or private data were sent.
